# SI016 — non-canonical-object-compared

Only the canonical verdict object may be compared.

## Why

Dict literals, timestamps, lengths, and provider names introduce validator-visible noise.

## Bad

```python
gl.eq_principle.strict_eq(lambda: {'verdict': raw})
```

## Good

```python
gl.eq_principle.strict_eq(evaluate)  # canonical return
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI016 -- reason
```
